sources.title: Beef, Lamb, Pork and Veal Roasting Chart
sources.author: U.S. Department of Health & Human Services
sources.rights_or_license: U.S. federal government food-safety guidance; citation and direct URL retained; no recipe text copied
sources.endpoint_summary: The official fresh-pork chart explicitly lists ribs and sets the chart minimum at 63 C with at least a 3-minute rest.
cannot_prove: It does not establish an automatic Northeast stew duration for household rib size or pot geometry.
Its 90-120 minute reference times cannot be written as a production default for this product.
It does not establish cornmeal hydration, stew liquid or pot-edge steaming time.

sources.title: 警惕四季豆中毒
sources.publisher: 湖北省卫生健康委员会
sources.author: 湖北省疾病预防控制中心
sources.rights_or_license: Official public-health guidance; citation and direct URL retained; facts summarized without copying a recipe
sources.endpoint_summary: For household four-season beans, the guidance requires cooking through evenly until raw green and bean odor are absent, including covered simmering at 100 C for more than 10 minutes in the stated method.
cannot_prove: It does not establish a shorter endpoint for pressure cookers, microwaves or other methods.
It does not prove that every food whose name contains the character 豆 belongs to this scope.
It does not establish a flavor or texture preference beyond the safety endpoint.

sources.title: 海南省食品安全委员会办公室食品安全消费提示（2017年第3号）
sources.publisher: 海南省市场监督管理局
sources.author: 海南省食品安全委员会办公室
sources.rights_or_license: Official food-safety consumer guidance; citation and direct URL retained; facts summarized without copying a recipe
sources.endpoint_summary: The guidance directly covers Northeast oil beans: cook through until pods are limp, color changes from bright to dark green and raw bean odor is absent, then continue cooking; long-heating methods such as stewing are preferred.
cannot_prove: It does not publish an exact minimum number of minutes for oil beans.
It does not permit borrowing the four-season-bean 10-minute number as an oil-bean default.
It does not establish ratios, serving scaling or a production recipe.

all_of.measurement: thickest edible meat portion, measured away from bone
after removal from the heat source before carving or eating

method_constraints: Use a food thermometer; color or tenderness alone cannot satisfy the endpoint.
The official time range is reference-only and cannot replace temperature measurement.

all_of.measurement: covered low simmer in the documented household method
continuous covered low simmer after adding water
all pods turned during cooking and no crowded cold spots
all pods have lost the original raw green appearance

method_constraints: This numeric endpoint applies only to the documented covered-simmer method.
Every condition is required; visual color alone is insufficient.

all_of.measurement: pods have changed from upright or stiff to limp
pod color has changed from bright green to dark green
oil beans were fully cooked after the preliminary boiling endpoint; short high-heat cooking is forbidden

method_constraints: Prefer a long-heating method such as stewing.
No exact minute value may be inferred from this source.
